description: Structured output: extracting fields into JSON, choosing a tool, filling a function call.

defaults.system: Answer ONLY with one valid JSON object, no explanation and no code block.

tasks.prompt:
Extract JSON with keys "sender", "amount" (a number) and "order_id" from this email:
From: Bol.com <noreply@bol.com>
Date: 12-10-2026
Your order #88123 of €49.95 has shipped.

Give JSON with "shop", "amount" (positive number) and "category" (one of: groceries, transport, subscription, other):
Debit 11-10 ALBERT HEIJN 1234 -€23,40 balance €310,10

Give JSON with "id", "severity" (low/medium/high/critical) and "patch" (true/false):
CVE-2026-1234, CVSS 9.8, remote code execution in nginx 1.24; patch available in 1.26.

Choose the right tool for the question. Tools: schedule_today, schedule_tomorrow, get_tests, get_homework. Reply as JSON {"tool": "<name>"}.
Question: What is the schedule tomorrow?

Convert the date to ISO 8601. Reply as JSON {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}.
Text: The invoice is due on 12 March 2026.

Extract JSON with "name", "phone" and "city":
Please call Jan de Vries on +31 6 1234 5678, he lives in Utrecht.
You can call get_weather(city, unit) where unit is "celsius" or "fahrenheit". Reply as JSON with the keys "function", "city" and "unit" to answer: What is the temperature in Rotterdam in Fahrenheit?

Classify the sentiment as "positive", "negative" or "neutral". Reply as JSON {"sentiment": "..."}.
Review: The battery died after two days and support never answered.

Count the items. Reply as JSON {"count": <number>}.
List: apples, pears, plums, grapes, figs
Reply as JSON {"total": <number>} with the sum of all amounts in: Coffee 3.50, Sandwich 6.25, Cake 4.75.

Does the text mention a deadline? Reply as JSON {"deadline": true or false, "date": "..." or null}.
Text: Please send the signed form before 15 November.
Reply as JSON with exactly the keys "a", "b", "c" and the values 1, 2, 3.
